terms.article1Body: Wedillybird ("the Service") provides a SaaS wedding-planning platform offering guest management, text invitations, RSVP tracking, check-in and shared photo galleries. These Terms of Service govern the use of the Service by anyone accessing it ("the User").
terms.article2Body: Use of the Service implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms. The User acknowledges having read and accepted them without reservation when creating their account.
terms.article3Body: Access to the Service requires creating an account by verifying a phone number. The User is responsible for the confidentiality of their number and for any action taken from their account. Any unauthorised use must be reported immediately.
terms.article4Body: The Service is offered with no free tier. For individuals planning a wedding, two one-shot plans are available: Essential ($40 / €29, core features + 30-day gallery) and Premium ($80 / €59, Essential + 6-month gallery + PDF album). A post-wedding upsell (+$30 / +€29) extends the gallery to 5 years and adds the HD photo book. For professionals, monthly or annual subscriptions (Starter $99 / €99 per month, Business $219 / €219 per month, Agency $449 / €449 per month, -20% annual) or pay-as-you-go ($79 / €79 per event). Payments are processed by Stripe. Full refund within 7 days if the event has not been sent. If the wedding is cancelled, free postponement to another date.
terms.article5Body: The User retains ownership of the content they upload. They grant Wedillybird a non-exclusive licence to use this content solely for the operation of the Service. Wedillybird retains ownership of the platform, its code and brand.
terms.article6Body: The Service is provided "as is". Wedillybird strives to ensure maximum availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted service. Wedillybird's liability is limited to the amount paid by the User over the past 12 months.
terms.article7Body: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their performance shall fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Paris courts, except for any contrary provision of public policy.
terms.description: Wedillybird Service Terms of Service: account, pricing, intellectual property, liability, governing law.
terms.article8Body: The User who uploads photos of guests (typically the couple) represents and warrants that they have informed their guests that photos will be shared through the Service and, where the optional face-search feature is enabled, that guests' faces will be processed to let them find their own photos, and that they have obtained any consent required under applicable law. The User is responsible for complying with the law of the place where the wedding is held regarding the biometric data of the people they invite. Wedillybird does not offer face search for weddings held in Illinois, Texas, or Washington.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controllerBody: Wedillybird, a platform operated by Tuum Agency, is the controller for the data collected through the Service.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: Phone number (authentication), name and email (profile), information related to the weddings being organised (dates, venues, guest lists), photos shared in the gallery, technical logs (IP, user-agent).
privacy.purposesBody: Provide the Service, authenticate users, send invitations and notifications, process payments, prevent fraud, improve the platform.
privacy.legalBasisBody: Performance of the contract (account, payments, features), legitimate interest (security, abuse prevention), consent (non-essential cookies, marketing communications).
privacy.retentionBody: Account data: duration of the subscription + 3 years. Payment data: legal duration (10 years for invoicing). Technical logs: 12 months maximum. Biometric face data (face search, when enabled): until the gallery expires or the feature is disabled, whichever comes first — see “Biometric data” below.
privacy.subprocessorsBody: Convex (database, US), Vercel (hosting, US/EU), Stripe (payments, EU/US), Twilio (SMS delivery, US/Canada), Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (message delivery, EU/US), Amazon Rekognition Faces (biometric face indexing for the optional face-search feature, only for weddings where the couple has explicitly opted in — see “Biometric data” below, EU). Data is minimised, never resold or shared with third parties for marketing. All bound by standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms.
privacy.biometricsBody: Face search is an optional, opt-in feature: it is OFF by default and only processes guests' faces for weddings where the couple has explicitly enabled it, after reviewing this notice. Legal basis: explicit consent, given by the couple on behalf of the wedding (see Terms of Service). Data processed: facial geometry extracted from approved gallery photos (Amazon Rekognition), used only to match a guest's selfie against the gallery — the selfie itself is never stored. Retention: until the gallery expires or the couple disables the feature, whichever comes first; deleted automatically within 24 hours by a daily purge job, or sooner on request. This feature is not offered for weddings held in Illinois, Texas, or Washington.
privacy.rightsBody: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability, restriction. To exercise a right, write to privacy@wedillybird.com. You can also file a complaint with the CNIL.
privacy.contactBody: Email: privacy@wedillybird.com. Reply within 30 days in line with the GDPR.

affiliation.title: Partner programme terms
affiliation.article1Body:
The Wedillybird partner programme allows a content creator, a wedding planner or anyone supporting couples to recommend Wedillybird and earn a commission on the sales they generate.
These terms govern the relationship between Wedillybird (“we”) and the person admitted to the programme (“the Partner”). They do not cover referrals between individuals, which earn credit usable on the Service and are governed by the Terms of Service.
affiliation.article2Body:
The programme is invitation-only: we create the partner account, its code and its link. An unsolicited application confers no right.
The Partner acts entirely independently. The programme creates no employment contract, no agency, no joint venture and no exclusivity either way. The Partner is responsible for their own tax and social security obligations and confirms holding, where their national law requires it, the status allowing them to issue an invoice.
affiliation.article3Body:
We provide the Partner with a referral link (in the form wedillybird.com/?ref=CODE) and, where a discount is offered to their audience, a promotional code carrying the same string.
The code applies to the couple plans (Essential and Premium). It applies neither to professional subscriptions nor to the post-wedding HD option.
The code is valid for twelve months from creation and may be renewed. The Partner may not transfer it, resell it, or create variants of it.
affiliation.article4Body:
A sale is attributed to the Partner in two cases:
— the buyer clicked their referral link within the previous thirty days; where several referral links were followed, the first one received carries the attribution;
— or the buyer entered their code at checkout.
No commission is due where neither condition is met, in particular if the buyer cleared their cookies or changed device without entering the code. The Partner earns no commission on their own purchases.
affiliation.article5Body:
The commission is a percentage of the amount actually collected by Wedillybird, after any discount and inclusive of all taxes. It is 20%, unless a different rate is agreed in writing with the Partner.
The discount granted to the audience and the Partner's commission may not together exceed 25% of the price.
Commissions are calculated and paid in the currency of the transaction, without conversion.
affiliation.article6Body:
A commission vests on the date of the wedding concerned, and no earlier than seven days after the purchase. That period matches the window during which the couple can still obtain a refund.
Before payout, a commission is cancelled if the corresponding purchase is refunded, unpaid or disputed with the bank. After payout, we may offset the corresponding amount against subsequent commissions.
affiliation.article7Body:
The Partner can see their attributed sales and the amount owed to them at any time from their partner space.
Vested commissions are paid by bank transfer, on request and at most once a month, within thirty days of receiving a compliant invoice. A minimum threshold of €50 applies; below it, the balance carries over to the next payout. Bank fees relating to a transfer outside the SEPA area remain payable by the Partner.
affiliation.article9Title: 9. Suspension and end of the programme
affiliation.article9Body:
Either party may end the programme at any time, without notice or compensation. The code and link are then deactivated and stop producing new attributions.
Absent any breach, commissions already vested and those still vesting are paid under article 7. In the event of a breach of the article 8 obligations, or of any scheme intended to create artificial sales, commissions not yet paid are forfeited.
affiliation.article10Body:
The Partner receives no information about buyers' identity: their space shows amounts, dates and statuses — never a name, an email address or an identifiable wedding.
The Partner's own data (identity, contact details, bank details) is processed to run the programme and pay commissions, and kept for as long as our accounting obligations require. How to exercise your rights is set out in the privacy policy.
affiliation.article11Body:
We may amend these terms. Any amendment is notified to the Partner thirty days before it takes effect and does not apply to sales already attributed.
These terms are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their performance falls within the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Paris, save for any mandatory provision to the contrary.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Wedillybird.

account.q: How do I create my account?
account.a: Click "Create an account", enter your phone number and type the 6-digit code received by text. No password needed.

invitations.q: How do I send invitations to my guests?
invitations.a: Add your guests from the "Manage guests" page, then send them the personalised link Wedillybird generates for each one. Every guest gets a unique QR code for check-in.

rsvp.a: Your guests reply directly from their personalised link. You see responses arrive in real time on your dashboard, with the count of confirmed, declined and pending.

checkin.a: Yes. The check-in page caches the guest list locally. You can scan QR codes even without a connection; data syncs as soon as the connection comes back.

gallery.q: Can my guests add photos to the gallery?
gallery.a: Yes. From their invitation page, they can upload photos that go through your moderation before appearing in the shared gallery.

pricing.a: Two one-shot plans per wedding: Essential ($40 / €29) for text invitations, RSVP, QR check-in and dashboard; Premium ($80 / €59) which adds a 6-month shared photo gallery and the final PDF album. A post-wedding upsell at +$30 (+€29) lets you keep your gallery for 5 years with an HD photo book and high-definition export.

support.a: Write to support@wedillybird.com. Reply within 24 business hours.

guestVsInvitation.q: What's the difference between an invitation and a guest?
guestVsInvitation.a: An invitation = one entry in your list corresponding to a primary person (e.g. your cousin Aminata) to whom you send a personalised link with their QR code. That person can indicate in their reply that they will be coming with N additional people (for example their partner and children). The plan quota counts the number of invitations sent, not the total number of people attending. So with the Sérénité plan (150 invitations), you can welcome far more than 150 actual people on the day.

manifesto.lede: You've probably received an invitation by email. You opened it once, maybe. Printed it? Never. Meanwhile, your guests are texting each other to confirm they're coming, ask for the address, share their photos. That's where a wedding lives today — in the conversation. That's where it should be organised.

whyWhatsapp.q: Why text instead of an email or a dedicated app?
whyWhatsapp.a: Because your guests are already there. Text gets a 98% open rate vs 22% for email, with no app and no account to create. In the US and Canada your guests receive an SMS; on WhatsApp worldwide. It's the most universal channel there is.

olderGuests.q: Will my older or less tech-savvy guests manage?
olderGuests.a: Yes. The invitation page opens in one tap, straight from the text — no app, no account to create. RSVP takes 3 buttons. More than 92% of grandparents tested confirmed without help.

guestLimit.q: What's the maximum number of guests?
guestLimit.a: No technical limit. The Essential and Premium plans include up to 500 invitations per wedding. Beyond that (weddings of 600+ guests), reach out — we'll adapt.

cancellation.q: What if we have to cancel or postpone the wedding?
cancellation.a: Free cancellation within 7 days of purchase. Beyond that, in case of cancellation, postponement of your event is free (up to 24 months). We've seen 2020 — your peace of mind comes first.

afterEvent.q: What do we keep after the wedding?
afterEvent.a: With Premium: moderated gallery for 6 months + final PDF album. With the post-wedding upsell at $30 (€29): we extend the gallery to 5 years, print an HD photo book and deliver a high-definition ZIP of every photo.

africa3g.q: How does it work without stable 4G?
africa3g.a: Day-of check-in works 100% offline (encrypted local IndexedDB cache). The gallery compresses photos before upload. The invitation page weighs less than 80 KB — tested on 3G with a 2-second load.

branding.q: Can the invitation design be customised?

data.q: What do you do with my guests' data?
data.a: Stored in Europe (Convex Frankfurt, Vercel Paris), encrypted at rest. No sharing with third parties, no advertising. Full deletion on request, in line with the GDPR. Details in our privacy policy.

difference.q: How are you different from HoneyBook?
difference.a: HoneyBook handles your quotes and contracts. So do we — but we go all the way to the big day: animated invitations, RSVP over WhatsApp, check-in at the door, seating plan and photo gallery. The wedding doesn't end at the signature, and neither does your tool.

money.q: Where does the money I collect go?
money.a: Straight to your own Stripe account. You connect yours, your couples' payments land with you, with no Wedillybird commission and no middleman.

data.a: You do. Your couples, your vendors, your documents stay yours. You can export everything to CSV whenever you like, without asking our permission.

cancel.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
cancel.a: Yes, no commitment. Your subscription stays active until the end of the paid period, then stops. No penalty, no notice.

overage.q: What happens if I exceed my quotas?
overage.a: Nothing blocking. Overages (messages, guests, storage) are billed as used, at the transparent rates shown above. You stay in control, with no nasty surprises.

beginner.q: I'm just starting out — is this too much for me?
beginner.a: No. The Starter plan covers five weddings in parallel and all the essentials. You move up a tier when your business grows — never before.

FaceSearchPrivacy.title: Privacy & face search
FaceSearchPrivacy.subtitle: Control whether guests can find their photos by face — off by default, your choice.
FaceSearchPrivacy.lockedBody: Face search is included in the Premium plan (and all pro plans).
FaceSearchPrivacy.stateHint: Required to enable face search if your wedding is in the United States or Canada — some states restrict biometric data.
FaceSearchPrivacy.toggleHint: Lets guests find their own photos by uploading a selfie. Off by default.
FaceSearchPrivacy.consentNoticeBody: Turning this on indexes guests' faces (Amazon Rekognition) so they can search their own photos with a selfie. By enabling it, you confirm you have informed your guests that face search is active for this wedding. You can turn it off at any time; indexed faces are deleted when the gallery expires or when you disable this setting.
FaceSearchPrivacy.bannedNotice: Face search isn't available for weddings in Illinois, Texas, or Washington — these states have specific biometric-data laws. This is a permanent restriction, not a bug.
FaceSearchPrivacy.errorStateBanned: Face search can't be enabled for this state.
FaceSearchPrivacy.errorStateRequired: Choose your wedding's state or province first. It's required to turn on face search.
FaceSearchPrivacy.errorFeatureNotInPlan: Face search is only available on the Premium plan (or pro plans).
FaceSearchPrivacy.errorForbidden: You don't have permission to change this setting.

InvitationDesign.title: Customize your invitation

seal.name: The Seal
seal.desc: The sealed envelope opens in real depth — the signature classic.

fairepart.name: The Invitation
fairepart.desc: Press the wax seal: it pops in 3D and the card opens onto your photo.

royal.name: The Royal Invitation
royal.desc: The palace doors swing open on your names engraved in gold — fireworks finale.

floral.name: The Bloom
floral.desc: A rosebud opens at dawn, then the garden leads you beneath the flowered arch.

cake.name: The Wedding Cake
cake.desc: The cake rises and your names are piped in icing, candles lit.

voyage.name: The Boarding
voyage.desc: The cabin window opens onto dawn — a boarding pass prints, then gets stamped.

theatre.name: The Curtain Rise
theatre.desc: The curtain rises on the swan lake — your names up in marquee lights.

etoiles.name: The Constellation
etoiles.desc: The night awakens: a heart is traced star to star, your names in starlight.

lanternes.name: The Lanterns
lanternes.desc: Lanterns light up and rise — your names glow through the paper.

rivage.name: The Shore
rivage.desc: The wave pulls back and your names remain written in the sand.

feux.name: The Fireworks
feux.desc: Rockets rise; the grand finale reveals your names in gold.

deco.name: The Art Deco
deco.desc: Black and gold: the frame draws itself, your names in Gatsby gold capitals.

Partner.linkHint: Any sale coming from a click on this link is attributed to you automatically.
Partner.codeHint: To be entered at checkout. Same discount, same commission — handy for your stories and posts.
